book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel Yesuyen Mere Basaŋ Marte Meteŋ

content: “Kadne yago, merem yaŋ nirhaŋ gayen pet teŋ nigeŋ ge tagaleŋ tihim ga nurnaŋ ko,” yinyiŋ.
Go yiriŋ gobe Yuda marte mere mat tike nurdeb liwlaw tiyamiŋ kuruŋ go bada heŋ balmiŋ palŋa iramiŋ. Irkeb Pol beleŋ,

“Nebe Yuda mar al, Silisia naŋare niŋ taunde Tarsus kawaŋ himiriŋ. Gega waŋ Yerusalem gar heŋ kuruŋ himiriŋ. Irkeb Gamaliel beleŋ nende tikula Mose beleŋ asininiŋ yago asaŋde kaŋ yunyiŋ goyen goke keŋkela wor po saba niryiŋ. Irkeb deŋ beleŋ gayenter Al Kuruŋ niŋ po nurde mata teŋ haŋ gahade gayen po ne wor gwaha teŋ saba upsiŋeŋ gama irde hinhem.
Irdeb Yesu beleŋ alya bereya gaha teŋ hinayiŋ yeŋ tikula kiryiŋ goyen gama irde hinhan mar goke biŋ arŋeŋ nurde yuneŋbe yade fere teŋ koyare yerdeb kurabe gasa yirmeke kamde hinhan.

Go teŋ hinhem gobe Al Kuruŋ doloŋ ird ird mata doyaŋ mar pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋya Yuda marte doyaŋ marya wor neneŋ hinhan geb, igiŋ momoŋ dirnayiŋ. Nebe mel go hitte kuŋ Damaskus taunde niŋ meteŋ kadom beleŋ faraŋ nurnayiŋ yeŋbe yinmeke asaŋ kaŋ nunamiŋ. Irkeb asaŋ go teŋbe Yesu niŋ dufay saŋiŋ irtiŋ mar goyen fere yirde Yerusalem gar yawaŋ buluŋ buluŋ yirniŋ yeŋ Damaskus taunde kumiriŋ.
“Be, kuŋ kuŋ naŋa baŋkahal hekeb Damaskus taun binde himekeyabe bemel po hulsi tareŋ kura naŋa folekkeŋ kuruŋ gore naŋkiŋde mat ne hitte po timiyyiŋ.
Irde gore nirkeb megen nakteŋ mununyiŋ. Irke al melak kura goreb, ‘Sol, Sol, daniŋ mununeŋ buluŋ buluŋ nirde ha?’ ninyiŋ.
“Irkeb Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ goyen, ‘Gebe ganuŋ?’ inmekeb, ‘Nebe Nasaret niŋ al Yesu, mununeŋ buluŋ buluŋ nirde ha al goyen,’ ninyiŋ.
Be, al neya tumŋaŋ kuŋ hinhet mar gobe hulsi go po ga kenamiŋ. Gega mere gobe al gore mere teŋ hi yeŋ ma bebak tiyamiŋ.
Gwaha ninkeb, ‘Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ, daha tiyeŋ tihim?’ inmekeb, ‘Huwara. Irde Damaskus taunde kwa. Gor gab gwaha gwaha tiyayiŋ yeŋ basiŋa girmiriŋ goyen nurayiŋ,’ ninyiŋ.
Be, hulsi kuruŋ gore nirke delne kidoma wor po hiriŋ geb, al kuŋ hinhet mar gore po nanarde nad Damaskus taunde kwamiŋ.
“Be, gorbe al kura deŋem Ananaias hinhin. Yeŋbe Yuda marte tikula keŋkela gama irde hiyen. Irkeb Yuda mar taun goyenter hinhan goreb palap wor po irde haŋyen.
Be, Ananaias gore ne hitte waŋ huwardeb, ‘Kadne, sopte delge wuk yeke naŋkena,’ yiriŋ.

Irkeb goyare po delne wuk yeke det yinmiriŋ. Irkeb yeŋ beleŋ gaha ninyiŋ: ‘Al Kuruŋ asininiŋ yago beleŋ hakot doloŋ irde hinhan Al goyen ge beleŋ gab dufaymiŋ keneŋ bebak teŋbe Al Huwak Yesu goyen delger forok yeŋ mere girkeb nurayiŋ yeŋ bikkeŋ basiŋa giryiŋ.
Niŋgeb gebe mata keneŋ mere nuraŋ goyen goke kuŋbe al naŋa kuruŋ ga hike kwa goyen momoŋ irde tukayiŋ.
Niŋgeb da doyaŋ irde ha? Huwarde kuŋbe baptais tekeb Al Kuruŋ beleŋ mata buluŋge halde gunyeŋ. Irkeb yeŋ doloŋ irayiŋ,’ ninyiŋ.
“Be, kamebe mulgaŋ heŋ Yerusalem wamiriŋ. Gorbe kuŋ Al Kuruŋyen ya balem bana heŋ mere irde heŋyabe yuwarwarte Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ kinmiriŋ.
Irkeb Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ, ‘Taunde gar niŋ marbe ge beleŋ ne niŋ tagalde ha gayen fudinde yeŋ ma nurde asogo girnayiŋ geb, araŋ po Yerusalem ga tubul teŋ hoyaŋde kwa,’ ninyiŋ.

Gega ne beleŋ huwardebe, ‘Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ, mel gobe epte ma asogo nirnayiŋ. Nebe meteŋ alge Stiwen hora po mayaŋ goyarebe gor hinhem. Irde al beleŋ Stiwen mayniŋ teŋ hikeb igiŋ nurde go mar gote uliŋhor yago doyaŋ yirde hinhem. Irde meteŋ alge Stiwen goyen hora po uguŋ kerke kamuŋ goyen kinmiŋ. Irdeb Yuda marte gabu yayaŋ kuŋ alya bereya ge niŋ dufaymiŋ tareŋ irtiŋ marbe yawaŋ yusulak teŋ koyare yerde hinhem. Niŋgeb Yerusalem niŋ mar gabe keŋkela nurde nuneŋ haŋ,’ inmiriŋ.
Gega Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ wol heŋbe, ‘Ne beleŋ po gad germeke naŋa gisaw al miŋ hoyaŋ Yuda mar moŋde naŋare kwayiŋ. Niŋgeb huwarde kwa!’ ninyiŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Be, al buda go meremiŋ palŋa iramiŋ kuŋ al miŋ hoyaŋ Yuda mar moŋ niŋ tagalke nurdeb biŋ ar yamiŋ. Irkeb, “Al gabe megen gar hitek moŋ niŋ, mayke kami!” yeŋ kwep kwep tiyamiŋ.
Irdeb al buda goreb Pol beleŋ Al Kuruŋ sukal ira yeŋ biŋ ar wor po yekeb kwep kwep teŋ uliŋhor yago yuguya teŋ mulowo yade naŋa kota yemeyde tiyamiŋ.

Irkeb fuleŋa marte doyaŋ al kuruŋ beleŋ fuleŋa marmiŋ go yinke Pol go teŋ fuleŋa marte yare tukamiŋ. Irkeb fuleŋa marte doyaŋ al kuruŋ gore, “Kuŋ usulak tike daniŋ merem yaŋ irde kwep kwep irde haŋ goyen momoŋ diryeŋ,” yineŋ hulyaŋ yiryiŋ.

Irkeb fuleŋa mar beleŋ kuŋ Pol goyen usulak tiniŋ yeŋ haniŋya kahaŋya yad giŋ yirdeb hete giti iramiŋ. Irkeb Pol beleŋ fuleŋa mar gote doyaŋ al kura gor hinhin goyen, “Roma mar al ne gahade gayen mere miŋ ma nurdeya mali yusulak tinayiŋ yeŋ Roma gabman beleŋ igiŋ yitiŋ we?” inyiŋ.
Irkeb fuleŋa marte doyaŋ al gob kuruŋmiŋ hitte kuŋbe “Al gabe Roma al geb, daha ireŋ taha?” inyiŋ.
Irkeb fuleŋa marte doyaŋ al kuruŋ gore Pol hitte kuŋbe, “Momoŋ nira. Ge gayen fudinde Roma al?” inyiŋ. Irkeb, “Fudinde,” yiriŋ.
Irkeb al gore, “Nebe Roma al hewe yeŋbe hora kuruŋ tubul teŋ gab Roma al himiriŋ,” inyiŋ. Irkeb Pol beleŋ, “Gebe gwaha tiyariŋ gega, Adonebe Roma al geb, ne wor Roma al,” inyiŋ.

Be, Pol go gwaha yeke nurdeb fuleŋa mar usulak teŋ gusuŋaŋ irniŋ yeŋ doyaŋ hamiŋ gobe warga heŋ okohom po bada hamiŋ. Irkeb Pol go Roma al gega, malikan miŋ miŋmoŋ fuleŋa marmiŋ yinke sende fere tiyamiŋ goke kafura hiriŋ.
Polbe merere huwaryiŋ

Irdeb nalu go wawuŋ heŋ sopte fay urkeb fuleŋa marmiŋ yinke Pol go sen yugu teŋ unamiŋ. Irde, “Da misiŋde wor po Yuda mar beleŋ Pol mere uliŋde iraŋ goyen upsiŋeŋ bebak tiye,” yeŋbe pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋya Yuda marte doyaŋ mar tumŋaŋ wake gabu irke gab gusuŋaŋ yire yeŋ mere kiryiŋ. Irkeb tumŋaŋ gabu irke fuleŋa marte doyaŋ al kuruŋ beleŋ Pol tawake al buda kuruŋ gote diliŋde huwaryiŋ.
